scope: The document identity (metadata + manifest + robots) and three accessibility fixes. Out of scope: product copy, a real icon set, and a production performance measurement.

acceptance_criteria.text: /manifest.webmanifest and /robots.txt both 200 with the expected fields; the title, description and theme-colour meta are in the served HTML.
The mode switch exposes role=group with aria-pressed; one h1 then an h2; the rotate button's accessible name contains its visible text.
verify green at the same test totals.
Lighthouse: no failing audits and 1.00 in all three scored categories.

open_questions: Whether the pilot wants to be crawlable later (it is a private workspace today, so robots disallows all).
risks: Radix ToggleGroup must exist in the installed radix-ui package; typecheck proves the import.
Swapping the header control changes its markup; no test asserted it, and the right-rail Tabs (which do have panels) are untouched.
